t: Minqing railway station - Wikipedia
s: January 25, 2025 - Minqing railway station (Chinese: 闽清站) is a railway station in Minqing County, Fuzhou, Fujian, China. It is an intermediate stop on the Nanping–Fuzhou railway. The station is currently used for freight handling only, but it previously handled passenger services.
